items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Gershwin I haven’t even mentioned. There’s just – you know, what a tradition we have in back of us of songwriting

ctx.x: And through the ages they have, Gershwin’s it’s always George it's never Ira and Ira was invaluable to George, as great as George was and believe me he was great.
Johnny Mercer might be the only exception because I've heard tunes referred to as Johnny Mercer tunes that were tunes where he actually wrote the lyric but not the music.
